name: Dual Antipodal VC Dimension
definition: A set of hypotheses $A\subseteq\mathcal H$ is **dually antipodally shattered** if, for every labeling $s:A\to\{0,1\}$, some point $x$ induces either $s$ or its bitwise complement on $A$. The **dual antipodal VC dimension** $\mathrm{VC}^{*a}(\mathcal H)$ is the largest size of such a set; equivalently it is the antipodal VC dimension of $\mathcal H^*$.
graph_summary: Largest hypothesis set whose every labeling is realized by a point, up to simultaneously flipping all labels.
description: Antipodal relaxation of dual VC dimension; distinct from the older parameter named dual sign rank, which is antipodal VC dimension rather than its dual.
origin_references: The antipodal-shattering formulation and its dual are used explicitly in \cite{chornomaz2025spherical}; antipodal VC was introduced under the name dual sign rank in \cite{alon2016sign}.

monotonic.proof: The class preorder monotonicity statement in Proposition 27 of \cite{chornomaz2025spherical} covers dual antipodal VC dimension and includes deletion of hypotheses.

p_monotonic.proof: The same preorder statement includes domain restriction, hence projections.

doubly_monotonic.proof: The cited preorder monotonicity establishes both subfamily and projection monotonicity.

c_monotonic.proof: Conditioning is restriction to a subfamily followed by a projection, so it follows from double monotonicity.
